name: AEGIS-DocIntel Complete MVP Audit Suite
description: Configuration specification for AEGIS-DocIntel multi-phase verification, validation, and release readiness audit.

quick.description: Fast verification of candidate freeze, dependency sync, core unit tests, linting, dataset contract, and API schema.

full.description: Exhaustive end-to-end verification covering all 7 audit phases: candidate freeze, environment, unit tests, quality gates, benchmarks, security/recovery, and build/release.

tests.description: Dedicated execution of all unit, integration, property, security, and recovery test suites.

benchmarks.description: Dedicated execution of evaluation benchmarks, mathematical knapsack proofs, and capacity latency profiles.

security.description: Dedicated execution of dependency audits, SAST, secret scanning, tenant isolation, and security acceptance suites.

status_definitions.PASS: The verification check executed successfully and strictly satisfied all defined assertions and thresholds.
status_definitions.FAIL: The verification check executed and failed one or more assertions or breached quality thresholds.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: The verification check could not execute because an upstream prerequisite or dependency failed.
status_definitions.NOT RUN: The verification check was excluded or not scheduled in the selected execution profile.
status_definitions.NOT APPLICABLE: The verification check applies only to environments or capabilities outside the evaluated scope.
